QuestInfo.name: The Missing
QuestInfo.1: The #bsinkhole#k cannot be explained by physics, and no one can get near it. Most believe the missing people are dead, but Jay thinks they might be in Maple World. See if Three Moon agrees.
QuestInfo.2: People who vanished into the #bsinkhole#k might be alive in Maple World. #bThree Moon#k is searching for evidence of this. Speak to him again.
QuestInfo.0: Jay will fill you in on what happened while you were gone. Go speak to Jay.

default.0: Shouldn't you be speaking to Three Moon?
